versions.changelog:
Initial release of sales-call-prep skill.

- Guides users through a ten-stage sales call preparation route for a given company.
- Generates a formatted PDF brief with key sales insights: account brief, earnings-call pain, contact role, discovery questions, opener, buying committee, objections, competitors, battle card, and follow-up plan.
- Requires only a company name as input; prompts for minimal additional info if needed.
- Ensures all research is sourced or clearly marked as inferred; logs gaps and user follow-up needs.
- PDF brief includes the three most call-changing findings and a draft follow-up email.
